observations: Photos show a black PlayStation console with the PlayStation logo on the front (photos 0, 1, 2).
No visible model label/serial number sticker is readable in the photos.
No ports, controller, cables, or power-on screen are shown.
The console surfaces show light wear/scratches consistent with used condition (photos 0-2).

claims.claim: PS4 Pro packs in twice the GPU power of the standard PS4 – letting you experience incredible image...
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos do not show the PS4 Pro model identifier (e.g., CUH model number) or any proof the unit is a Pro.

risks.risk: The console may not be a PS4 Pro (could be standard PS4 or another variant), since the photos don’t show the model number/label.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the console’s underside/side label showing the CUH model number (e.g., CUH-7xxx for Pro) and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a standard PS4 (worst-case vs claimed Pro).

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (no power-on test shown).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the console powering on, reaching the home screen, and playing a game or running a system test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/untested (worst-case: treat as needing repair or unreliable).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incomplete package (no box, controller, HDMI/power cable shown).
risks.proof: Photos of everything included laid out: controller(s), power cable, HDMI cable, and any box/manual.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (worst-case: no controller/cables).

risks.risk: Storage/RAM/HDD condition unknown (no capacity shown; could be low or failing).
risks.proof: Photo of System Settings → Storage (or a screenshot) showing total storage and free space; optionally a SMART/health check if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lowest practical storage/unknown health.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the underside/side label with the CUH model number and serial number (to confirm PS4 Pro vs standard).
Video proof of power-on to the PS4 home screen (and ideally launching a game).
Photos of included items: controller(s), HDMI cable, power cable, and any box/receipt.
Screenshot/photo of System Settings showing storage capacity.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a PlayStation console, but they do not provide readable model identifiers or any power-on/testing proof to verify it’s specifically a PS4 Pro and working. Without that, a worst-case price can’t be confidently set.
